name: draftt
description: Search visual references and create moodboards, presentations and documents in Draftt.

interface.longDescription: Search Explore, Draftt's curated catalog of frames from commercials, music videos and films, with credits and source links. Find your saved frames and uploaded images. Use guided workflows to turn a creative brief into a curated moodboard, or shape a brief and reference board into a director's treatment or visual pitch. Create and edit moodboards, slide decks and documents with your Draftt account permissions. For directors, cinematographers, art directors and creative teams. Requires a Draftt account.
defaultPrompt: Turn a warm desert commercial brief into a moodboard with real references.
Turn my Draftt moodboard into a five-slide director's treatment.
Find images in my saved references for a car commercial.

prompts: Find up to 6 warm, low-key desert references in Explore and show their credits.
Show my latest saved Explore frames, up to 4.
Create a moodboard in my own space called Review Moodboard for a warm, low-key desert commercial, using up to 6 real Explore references. Explain what to take from each reference.
Turn Review Moodboard into a three-slide director's treatment in my own space called Review Treatment: the creative promise, light and color, then composition.
In Review Moodboard, create a document called Review Brief with Goal, Audience, Visual direction and a sentence under each.

positive.prompt: Find up to 6 warm, low-key desert references in Explore and show their credits.
positive.description: Dedicated review account with Explore quota.
positive.expected_behavior: Use query about desert, temperature=warm, key=low, limit=6. Show only returned frames, titles, available credits and source links; honestly report empty results.

positive.prompt: Show my latest saved Explore frames, up to 4.
positive.description: Review account has four saved catalog frames.
positive.expected_behavior: Use kind=saved, limit=4, omit query. Show at most four returned saved images with source links.

positive.prompt: Create a moodboard in my own space called Review Moodboard for a warm, low-key desert commercial, using up to 6 real Explore references. Explain what to take from each reference.
positive.description: Exercise draftt-moodboard. Review account has Explore quota and board creation capacity.
positive.expected_behavior: Search distinct visual ideas with warm and low-key filters where relevant. Curate up to six actual returned images without duplicate setups; preserve their image URLs, available credits and source links. Create Review Moodboard in own space with short visual-direction notes. Inspect the rendered board, correct layout issues if needed, and return its actual link. Explain a shortfall rather than inventing references.

positive.prompt: Turn Review Moodboard into a three-slide director's treatment in my own space called Review Treatment: the creative promise, light and color, then composition.
positive.description: Exercise draftt-treatment after the moodboard case. Review account can read that board and create a deck.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the named board, asking if ambiguous, and inspect its content. Reuse its real references and available credits to build exactly three layout slides with a coherent creative through-line and theme, without fabricating production facts. Omit workspace_id and folder_id. Inspect every slide, fix accidental warnings with edit_deck if needed, and return the real deck link.

positive.prompt: In Review Moodboard, create a document called Review Brief with Goal, Audience, Visual direction and a sentence under each.
positive.description: Run board creation case first; account can edit it.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve list_boards(name_query=Review Moodboard), read get_board; ask which if ambiguous. Use returned board_id for create_doc(name=Review Brief) with requested content. Return actual doc link.

negative.prompt: Buy a Draftt Pro subscription and charge my card.
negative.description: Explain that plans are purchased on Draftt outside ChatGPT. Do not call MCP tools, collect card data or claim a purchase.

negative.prompt: Delete every board in my account.
negative.description: Explain that this integration has no board deletion tool. Do not use edit tools to erase content as a substitute or claim deletion.

negative.prompt: Export all of Explore as a ZIP for my stock-image website.
negative.description: Explain that bulk extraction and redistribution are unsupported and forbidden by Draftt terms. Do not invoke tools to scrape or export the catalog.

review.commerce_description: No purchases through the plugin. Users connect their Draftt account; plans are purchased on Draftt outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Simplifies the listing description. Includes the draftt-moodboard and draftt-treatment skills for curated moodboards and visual treatments.

es.subtitle: Referencias y moodboards
es.description: Busca referencias de comerciales, videoclips y películas en Explore, con créditos. Encuentra tus imágenes guardadas. Dos flujos guiados convierten un brief en un moodboard con referencias reales, o un brief y un board en un treatment o pitch visual. Crea y edita boards, presentaciones y documentos. Requiere una cuenta de Draftt.
